q: Is pressure washing safe for my siding and plants?
a: For delicate surfaces (stucco, vinyl, painted wood) we use soft washing — low pressure with plant-safe detergents. We rinse and cover landscaping before starting. Your plants and finishes are protected.

q: How long does a typical job take?
a: A driveway is usually 1–2 hours. A full house wash 2–4 hours. A roof soft wash 2–3 hours. We can also bundle services in a single visit.

q: Do I need to be home?
a: We only need access to an outdoor water spigot. You don't need to be home — many customers book us while they're at work. We send before/after photos when we're done.
Pressure washers actually use less water than a garden hose for the same job because of the higher pressure. A driveway typically uses 50–80 gallons total — pennies on your water bill.
Light rain is fine — sometimes it helps. We'll reschedule heavy storms for safety and free of charge.

q: Can you remove specific stains (oil, rust, paint)?
a: Yes — we carry specialty cleaners for oil, rust, and paint. Send us a photo when you request a quote so we know what we're tackling.
Yes. Full liability insurance and workers comp. We're happy to share documentation before booking.
